title: Allard regularity on any radius (Simon Remark 5.5.3)
statement: For n >= 1, l, p > n and every gamma in (0,1) there are delta_0 in (0,1) and C, depending on gamma,n,l,p, such that for every open U, V with generalized mean curvature H, 0 < delta <= delta_0 and rho with AllardHypotheses H p delta rho, AllardConclusion V p delta rho gamma C holds (the conclusion of Theorem 5.2 on the ball of radius gamma rho, with constant C).
